title: Physical products that are quietly selling out this quarter
author: Editorial
excerpt: Sell-outs leave trails in restock delays, resale chatter, and companion demand. Here is what we are tracking.
body:
Physical sell-outs look noisy on social but quiet in data until you know where to look. Inventory gaps, third-party markup, and "back soon" pages are stronger signals than viral clips.

Categories cycling this quarter: desk objects, ritual goods, and limited-run apparel with a story. Each creates companion whitespace — organizers, care kits, digital add-ons.

Do not chase every sold-out SKU. Chase sell-outs with a clear audience and a repeatable use case. One-time hype without ritual does not support a companion business.

When you spot a pattern, write the window in days, not weeks. Physical attention decays fast. Futura Nota is built for that decay curve — detect, decide, ship before the spike fades.
